decisions.reason: The DCDC1 requirement already states its unchanged normal-operation role when the power board is connected; adding an OR-ed standalone USB source does not alter DCDC1 regulation or rating.
AXP2101 remains the source for all loads during normal battery-powered operation; the LDO applies only when the power board is absent.
The standalone LDO supplies the 3.3V rail and does not change the MT3608 enable control, rating, or established 5V sensor loads.
The source changes USB-derived power availability for standalone programming, not the native USB data lines, connector sourceability, routing, enumeration, or flashing interface.
The standalone 3.3V supply decision does not change the charge-status display method, GPIO, or dedicated charge-LED circuit.
Schottky-diode source selection on the shared rail does not change the established interboard connector partition, types, or signal pinout.
The electrical behavior of the standalone main-board LDO does not alter power-board dimensions, orientation, mounting, or USB-C placement.
Operating the main board without the power board does not add, remove, or merge any board in the established four-board topology.
Powering I2C sensors from the shared 3.3V rail does not change bus speed, cable length, pull-up placement, or series-resistor policy.
The source defines power-source behavior but does not change BOM completion, part-number, component-justification, or charge-LED assembly requirements.
The condition that the power board is disconnected does not modify connector placement, orientation, spacing, mounting-hole clearance, or physical accessibility.

The standalone 3.3V LDO decision does not change the selected SK6812 family or GPIO13 data interface; the separate conditional note about possible 5V wiring establishes no definite change to this requirement.
